changes: Rough shopping groups menu lines by canonical ingredient name and displays per-dish stored recipe quantities and units, rather than converted totals. Manual entries stay independent.
Remove rough quantity column and estimate/review badges; widen overview and memo column; copy uses per-dish amounts.
Existing rough purchase command handles the complete ingredient group atomically, preserving per-unit purchases and receipts while creating one adequate stock lot. Undo and group hide retain history.

Rough manual items allow empty quantity and/or unit. Original display values are retained in synchronized steward_meta:shopping metadata; internal purchase counters are not displayed as user-entered amounts.

checks.regression: Mixed g/box dish requirements, grouped purchase and retry identity, one stock lot, undo, group hide, name-only manual persistence and purchase, manual independence, legacy receipts, exact-mode UI.

limitations: Changes target rough shopping; exact-mode quantity accounting and shared historical unit conversion remain available.
Isolated SQLite and browser IPC tests; no live model, production two-device sync or overwrite installation test.
